hypothesis: Adding origin-available news, infrastructure and BLS features lowers seven-day quantile pinball versus the identical price-only learner.
classification: New prospective provider-quote cohort; separate from all competition targets and frozen studies
registration: GitHub configuration committed before capture/issuance; protocol hash bound into every record

price_source.credit: GPU Rental Prices. GPU rental price index [dataset]. https://gpurentalprices.com/data
price_source.measure: Advertised per-provider exact-configuration offer; not transactions or guaranteed capacity
price_source.selection: First two lexicographically ordered exact-configuration contracts per A100/H100 family, on-demand only; price-independent selection; freeze at first successful capture

signals.availability: Content first observed by cutoff; publication date alone cannot backdate availability; date-only publication upper bound is end of its UTC day
signals.operational_rule: No inferred delivered capacity; requires separately verified structured source record. Missing operational evidence stays missing.
signals.vintages: BLS responses retained by hash. Current revisions available only at current retrieval; no retroactive edits to older feature rows.

learner.family: Ridge on matured same-horizon log changes; empirical training-residual q10/q50/q90 shifts
learner.missing: Training-column median imputation with explicit missing flags; scale fitted on training only
learner.quantiles: Positive multiplicative quantiles from separate chronological calibration residuals; all arms share identical fit/calibration labels
learner.refit: Same deterministic refit at every eligible origin, using only labels matured by its cutoff
learner.calibration: Last8 matured chronological examples held out from Ridge fit; minimum24 fit examples; residual quantiles on those8; no exchangeability guarantee

reference_definition: Separate new-source adapters mirror official multiplicative log-change definitions where verified; never claim byte identity with old target exports
chronos: Optional added fixed control only after adapter parity; not in this first signal-factorial implementation

eligibility.primary: Frozen target has current compatible quote at origin; >=56 retained price observations and >=28 matured same-horizon examples with actual as-of signal snapshots. Failures visible; no baseline substitution for failed factorial arms.
eligibility.group_attribution: Need actual variation: >=3 distinct BLS observation periods first-seen in retained vintages; >=8 distinct news events; >=5 distinct infrastructure events. These are identifiability screens, not a statistical power guarantee.
eligibility.pilot: One immediate cold-start last-value commitment after first registered capture; no signal-value comparison, zero-width reference quantiles explicitly uncalibrated; excluded from primary analysis

scoring.metric: Mean pinball over quantiles, then equal matched cell weights
scoring.cohorts: A100 and H100 separate plus prespecified pooled result; only identical valid paired cells; report all exclusions
scoring.truth: Earliest retained compatible snapshot of the target UTC observation date, requiring provider fetched_at date == target_date; evaluator unlocks only after end of target date. Later revisions never selected by score.
scoring.analysis: Descriptive per-origin outcomes after full 7-day maturity; one final confirmatory analysis after all26 origins mature. No performance-based stopping.
scoring.inference: Origin-cluster paired mean differences; four-origin moving-block bootstrap fixed seed17, 2000 replicates, only with >=16 eligible origins; dependent markets and limited power explicit.
scoring.primary_comparison: 111 versus000; separately compare111 with drift. Individual group effects are secondary paired factorial ablations with Holm correction; insufficient variation forbids group-benefit claim.
scoring.promotion: Primary factorial configurations stay frozen through panel. Incumbent000 retained unless a separately registered challenger passes its future confirmatory block; no promotion on dev results or interim peeks.

memory.fallback: Explicit canonical fallback; never counted as successful recall

training.new_optimization: Gated until informative chronological tasks or human-checked extraction labels exist
training.synthetic: Contract fixtures only, never market accuracy

protected_dates.rule: No protected competition truth downloads; collector uses current snapshot only, never historical price endpoints

publication.current_price_rows: Selected CC BY4 quote derivatives with attribution; source_quote fields remain private
publication.news: Links, metadata and authored feature counts; raw retrieval bodies private
publication.commitments: Append-only hash-addressed Modal artifacts with provider execution logs; initial records additionally anchored in nonforce GitHub commit. Future automatic GitHub anchoring unavailable without a long-lived publishing credential; disclose this trust boundary.
